_about: W-analysis store: one record per 2010 federal polling place keyed to the four SEIFA 2006 indexes (irsd/irsad/ier/ieo scores + national deciles) via the CD (ASGC 2006) polygon containing the booth's premises coordinates. The area is the area OF THE PREMISES — a geographic proxy for the catchment's SES, not an aggregate of catchment voters; compare across census vintages by decile only. Each scored booth also carries seifa.pct (its area's score percentile inside the measured census's cube) and seifaInterp, an interpolated percentile between this election's two bracketing censuses (day-shared; method and factors in _pcti) — the comparable-across-vintages field. Coordinate-less mobile/hospital teams carry note=noCoords; cube-suppressed areas carry note=seifaSuppressed with seifa:null. stateFlag is a guard report only; the physical premises location wins.

_pcti.method: seifa.pct = the prePrefs area's score percentile among all scored areas of the measured cube (ascending score, min-rank on ties, most-disadvantaged low; r6 half-up). seifaInterp keys a second point-in-polygon join of the same premises coords against the OTHER bracketing census-era geometry; pcti = (1-f)*pct0 + f*pct1 computed from the emitted r6-rounded pct0/pct1/f (the file re-derives its own pcti). Rank percentiles interpolate absolute SES position across re-based editions; raw scores never do. Booths whose far-side point lands outside any polygon (interpFarOutside) or in a score-suppressed area (interpFarSuppressed) carry pct only.
